name: Retail
tagline: Unify merchandising, inventory, and CX with agents that act across the commerce stack.
overview: Retail margins are squeezed by stockouts, markdown waste, and slow customer service handoffs. Agentic AI connects planning, store ops, and support so decisions move at the speed of demand.
painPoints: Buyers react late to demand shifts and promo leakage
Inventory is siloed between DC, store, and marketplace channels
CX agents lack real-time order and inventory context
strategicImpact: Faster promo response with less margin erosion
Higher first-contact resolution in customer care

singleAgents.name: Demand Pulse Agent
singleAgents.role: Detects demand anomalies and recommends buy/transfer actions

singleAgents.name: Promo Compliance Agent
singleAgents.trigger: Promo launch or price mismatch alert
singleAgents.roi: Hours saved per promo week + recovered margin

singleAgents.name: Order Concierge Agent
singleAgents.role: Resolves order, shipping, and return inquiries end-to-end
singleAgents.trigger: Customer message tagged as order issue
singleAgents.output: Resolved case or precise escalation packet

singleAgents.name: Assortment Insight Agent
singleAgents.roi: Half-day prep cut to under an hour

multiAgent.name: Omnichannel Fulfillment Pod
multiAgent.description: Coordinates promise, pick, and exception handling when a customer order can be fulfilled from multiple nodes.

supervisor.name: Fulfillment Supervisor
supervisor.responsibilities: Chooses optimal node, monitors SLA risk, and re-promises when inventory or labor constraints change.
supervisor.routingLogic: Availability → Inventory Agent; labor/capacity → Store Ops Agent; delay risk → Customer Comms Agent; carrier issue → Logistics Agent.

subAgents.name: Store Ops Agent
subAgents.contextHandoff: Feasible pick plan or rejection reason

multiAgent.conflictResolution: If store capacity and inventory disagree, supervisor prefers DC fulfillment; customer-impacting re-promises require CX policy checks; hard failures create human ops tickets.

workflow.label: Input
workflow.description: Order event arrives with cart, promise date, and channel constraints.

workflow.label: Reason
workflow.description: Supervisor scores fulfillment options by margin, speed, and risk.

workflow.label: Tool Execution
workflow.description: Reserve stock, assign pick wave, book carrier, and update OMS.

workflow.label: Human-in-the-Loop
workflow.description: Ops intervenes on VIP orders, fragile SKUs, or repeated SLA breaches.

workflow.label: Output
workflow.description: Customer gets accurate ETA; inventory and labor systems stay in sync.
